nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) balances: stores the token balance of every account.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance: stores spender allowances granted by owners.
uint public totalSupply = 9000000000 * 10 ** 18: fixed token supply minted to the deployer.
string public name = 'GANGNOMIC': token name.
string public symbol = 'GANGNOMIC': token symbol.
uint public decimals = 18: token decimal precision.
constructor(): assigns the whole totalSupply to msg.sender, making the deployer the sole initial holder.
balanceOf(address owner) public view returns(uint): read-only accessor returning balances[owner].
transfer(address to, uint value) public returns(bool): moves value from msg.sender to 'to' after a balance check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value) public returns(bool): moves value from 'from' to 'to' when balance and allowance are sufficient; the allowance is never decremented.
approve(address spender, uint value) public returns(bool): unconditionally sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and allowance spender.
owner: address argument of balanceOf, used to index the balances mapping.
to: recipient address argument of transfer.
value: amount argument of transfer, used in the balance additions and subtraction.
from: source address argument of transferFrom, used to index balances.
to: recipient address argument of transferFrom.
value: amount argument of transferFrom, used in the balance additions, subtraction and allowance check.
spender: address argument of approve that receives the allowance.
value: allowance amount argument of approve written into the allowance mapping.
balances[to] += value inside transfer: unguarded credit of an arbitrary recipient address, including address(0), before the sender debit.
balances[msg.sender] -= value inside transfer: debit of the caller balance, executed only after the credit.
balances[to] += value inside transferFrom: credit of an arbitrary recipient while the spender allowance is never consumed.
balances[from] -= value inside transferFrom: debit of an owner-selected balance authorized only by the allowance check.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value inside approve: unconditional overwrite of the allowance without any validation or race protection.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the constructor to receive the whole totalSupply, creating an implicitly privileged deployer account.
totalSupply is read by the constructor to initialise balances[msg.sender].
transfer authorizes the debit solely on the identity of msg.sender, which is an untrusted caller.
transferFrom uses msg.sender both as allowance owner lookup and as spender, an untrusted authorization input.
approve writes the allowance of msg.sender, which is fully controlled by the untrusted caller.
msg.sender indirectly determines the sending account that funds the balances[to] credit in transfer.
the caller-supplied 'to' parameter is used as the index of the balances credit in transfer.
the untrusted 'value' parameter is added into balances[to], an arithmetic balance mutation.
msg.sender indexes the balance that is debited by transfer.
the untrusted 'value' parameter is subtracted from balances[msg.sender], an arithmetic balance mutation.
execution of transfer reaches the balances[to] += value statement after the balanceOf check.
execution of transfer reaches the balances[msg.sender] -= value statement.
the untrusted 'from' parameter drives the allowance/balance checks that gate the credit in transferFrom.
the caller-supplied 'to' parameter is used as the index of the balances credit in transferFrom.
the untrusted 'value' parameter is added into balances[to] in transferFrom.
the untrusted 'value' parameter is subtracted from balances[from] in transferFrom.
the untrusted 'from' parameter indexes the balance that is debited in transferFrom.
the untrusted 'from' parameter flows into transferFrom as the account being spent.
execution of transferFrom reaches the balances[to] += value statement after the allowance check.
execution of transferFrom reaches the balances[from] -= value statement, while the allowance is never decremented.
msg.sender is the allowance owner whose entry is overwritten by approve without restriction.
the untrusted 'spender' parameter is used as the allowance mapping key in approve.
the untrusted 'value' parameter is written verbatim as the new allowance in approve.
execution of approve reaches the allowance write statement.
balanceOf reads the balances state variable and returns it.
the 'owner' parameter is used as the lookup key by balanceOf.
transfer reads balances (via balanceOf and the direct updates) to validate and modify the sender balance.
transferFrom reads balances of 'from' and 'to' to validate and modify them.

normalization_plan.reason: the 'owner' parameter has no meaning outside balanceOf and is only used as the balances lookup key.
the 'to' parameter is a temporary argument of transfer and collapses into the function's recipient handling.
the 'value' parameter is a temporary argument of transfer that only feeds the balance updates performed by the function.
the 'from' parameter is a temporary argument of transferFrom that only feeds the balance updates performed by the function.
the 'to' parameter is a temporary argument of transferFrom and collapses into the function's recipient handling.
the 'value' parameter is a temporary argument of transferFrom that only feeds the allowance check and balance updates.
the 'spender' parameter is a temporary argument of approve used only as the allowance mapping key.
the 'value' parameter is a temporary argument of approve written directly into the allowance mapping.
